issues.title: Disprove 00000008776: residual sampling need not improve on uniform SGD
issues.body:
Disproves the explicit strict improvement claim for residual-based optimal sampling over uniform SGD. The actual consistent overdetermined system with two identical nonzero scalar rows has identical gradients and uniform residual-based weights. Every genuine row update halves the state, so both algorithms have exactly the same full probability laws, expected errors, and convergence rate.

Includes a complete LaTeX/PDF proof and pinned Lean verification of the actual matrix, gradients, least-squares minimizer, diagonal preconditioner, normalized weights, row PMFs, bind-generated SGD laws, actual Bochner expectations and convergence. The report explains that identical rows are allowed and leaves the possible worst-case Kaczmarz interpretation and other clauses untouched.

Validation: successful full lake build with printed standard-only axiom audits, and both PDF pages compiled/rendered/visually checked.
